messages:
maria: Heads-up — EU GPU autoscale rollout started, CI apply failed with a terraform state lease reset. Anyone seen this one before?

ci-bot: [CI] terraform apply failed: infra/gpu-pools (run 9842)

```
Error: Failed to acquire state lock: lease lost
  on backend.tf line 12, in resource \"terraform\"
  ...
```

ashwin: which backend + region? s3+dynamo or something else?

maria: s3 + dynamodb, eu-west-1, workspace=prod, pool=gpu-eu-sim. autoscaler triggered the pipeline ~11:02UTC. gitops/flux also reconciled around same time.

jenna: quick hypothesis: concurrent changes — flux helm update touching nodegroups + autoscaler provisioning new nodes via CI -> two separate processes trying to operate on the same tfstate.

ashwin: can you paste the DynamoDB lock record? run: 

```
aws dynamodb get-item --table-name tfstate-locks --key '{"LockID":{"S":"root/infra/gpu-pools"}}' --region eu-west-1
```

sample output will show HolderID/LeaseDuration/ExpiresAt.

kai: I poked the table, there was a LockOwner of "ci-run-9842" and ExpiresAt jumping around — looks like the lease was being renewed then dropped when the CI runner lost network to the regional metadata endpoint. intermittent network hiccup + two contenders.

maria: that matches the CI logs: runner lost contact with metadata for ~8s and then terraform returned lease lost. Meanwhile flux kicked off a helm chart that caused an immediate nodegroup scaling event. bad timing.

jenna: short-term mitigation: pause flux/GitOps reconcile for the cluster, re-run the CI apply after the lock is clean, and revive flux afterwards. Longer-term: prevent concurrent automation targeting infra state.

ashwin: agree. also we should add exponential retry + jitter to the CI terraform step and increase the dynamodb lease TTL from 30s -> 60s to cover brief network flaps. plus a pre-apply guard that checks for recent flux reconciles.

kai: for manual recovery I ran: 

```
# check lock
aws dynamodb get-item --table-name tfstate-locks --key '{"LockID":{"S":"root/infra/gpu-pools"}}' --region eu-west-1
# if stale, delete (only if you're sure)
aws dynamodb delete-item --table-name tfstate-locks --key '{"LockID":{"S":"root/infra/gpu-pools"}}' --region eu-west-1
```

(only ran delete after confirming no active runner).

ops-bot: I can pause flux for cluster eu-gpu-prod for a 20m window. Confirm start time.

maria: please pause at 11:40UTC for 20m. I'll re-run apply at 11:45UTC and report back.

jenna: follow-up action items: 1) add pipeline guard that checks for a recent flux/helm reconcile timestamp and aborts if < 2m, 2) increase dynamodb lease TTL to 60s, 3) add retry with jitter in terraform step, 4) add a small dedicated lock for autoscaler runs so it won't spin up parallel CI applies.

ashwin: I'll open a short RFC with the changes and a rollout plan.

maria: thanks — will post result after re-run. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: [CI] re-run scheduled by maria (run 9843) at 11:45UTC

maria: re-run succeeded, no more lease errors. will follow up with RFC doc link once ashwin creates it.
